reports.title: BorgWarner Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results

lines: At the midpoint of its 2026 guidance, the Company expects to deliver another year of adjusted operating margin expansion and adjusted earnings per share growth despite the Company’s expectation that its weighted light vehicle market will be down 2% to down 1% and a $10 million to $15 million industrial R&D investment to support long-term profitable growth.
Net sales are expected to be in the range of $14.0 billion to $14.2 billion in 2026, compared with 2025 net sales of approximately $14.3 billion.

The Company’s net sales guidance includes an expected year-over-year sales decline of approximately $250 million in the Company’s Battery Energy Systems segment, which represents approximately a 1.7% headwind to organic net sales growth in 2026.
GAAP operating margin is expected to be in the range of 9.3% to 9.6% in 2026.

Full year operating cash flow is expected to be in the range of $1,600 million to $1,700 million, while free cash flow is expected to be in the range of $900 million to $1,100 million, consistent with the Company’s previous guidance.
